issue: देहि सकल बाँछित फल शीशा: शीशा is 'head', and the line names no giver; the meaning keeps the plain words.
our reading: Whoever reads the Chālīsā a hundred times is given every fruit he desires, upon his head.
alternatives: शीशा as the rhyme form of ईश, 'the Lord' (as -ईसा in other chālīsās): 'the Lord gives him every fruit he desires'; or 'I bow my head'.

issue: सन महँ (line 3) read as मन महँ 'in their hearts' (both witnesses print सन; सन महँ, two postpositions, gives no sense). (जयरामदेव is settled as the poet's signature: the book prints it in quotation marks, its mark for the poet's name.)
